summary: Fixed StrPrinter product denominator grouping for reciprocal powers (including inverse square roots) in both ordinary and unevaluated-product branches. Added issue 21612 regression reproducing the exact nested-fraction expression, checking its string round-trip, and covering both printing branches. Before the fix, test_str.py had 100 passed and the new regression failed; after the fix, all 101 passed. Related test_python.py and test_repr.py had 55 passed and 1 expected failure. Direct LaTeX parsing could not run because antlr4 is unavailable; test_latex.py was included in the follow-up test command but did not execute tests. Reviewed final diff.
